messages:
Priya Rao: Quick heads-up — DeepBench EAP: connector + marketplace listing. NDA signed by partner, legal shared redlined copy here: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/DEEPBENCH-NDA. Need to lock SLA, bench targets, and telemetry plan by EOD Tue.
Samira Chen: Ack. can we get access to their hardware images this week? want to run the perf harness.
Alex Morales: Legal confirmed the NDA is good-to-go. I attached the final in the doc above. No export restrictions flagged.
Jon Park: For telemetry, we'll need prefix caching telemetry + token-level latency traces. plan: wire `rbw-telemetry:v2` with a small sampling rate.
Priya Rao: Samira — DeepBench can ship images Wed AM. Can you validate tooling works by Thu? QA Lab gave us 2 bench slots Fri/Sat.
Samira Chen: Sounds good. I'll scope minimal harness: 1) correctness pass 2) throughput sweep 3) tail-latency. Perf targets proposal: `p50 < 70ms`, `p95 < 250ms` on DeepBench-X1@16k context. Thoughts?
Jon Park: Those targets look reasonable for our baseline model. Add a fallback path in the runtime to `deepbench-x1-quant` if memory pressure spikes.
Alex Morales: Ops/Sales asked for SLA language: propose "99.5% availability for reserved pools, 99% for preview shared" + an incident response commitment. Legal wants non-inferrable metrics only.
Priya Rao: We should be explicit about embargo/announce cadence. Partner asked for a "soft announcement" after successful bench run + a joint press by two weeks after GA. We need to confirm dates.
QA Lab: FYI scheduled bench slots: Fri 02:00-06:00 UTC and Sat 14:00-18:00 UTC. Please upload bench configs to the shared drive: https://drive.redwood/apps/deepbench/eap-configs
Samira Chen: Uploading harness now. command to run: `./run_bench --profile deepbench-x1 --streaming false --warmup 500`
Priya Rao: @Alex Morales can you confirm the marketplace listing copy is safe? partner provided draft, we need to ensure no PII and that we don't imply GA.
Alex Morales: I reviewed the copy — removed legalese that claims GA. updated file in the drive. please use `deepbench-listing-v2.md`.
Jon Park: Quick note on metrics: please include cold-start numbers. we saw 800-1200ms cold p95 on a previous board; want that captured.
Samira Chen: noted. will capture cold and warm runs separately and attach artifacts (logs + flamegraphs).
Priya Rao: Great. Action items: Samira run harness + upload results (Due: Fri EOD), Jon wire telemetry + sampling (Due: Thu), Alex finalize marketplace copy + NDA final (Done). I'll coordinate partner PR timeline and confirm announce window by Mon. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: bench-run queued: job_id=DB-EAP-4721, eta Fri 02:00 UTC. Logs will appear in /runs/DB-EAP-4721
Priya Rao: Thanks team — let's sync briefly Thu 09:00 PT to confirm readiness. If anyone needs extra bench time, ping here. :rocket:
